head.description: UPerNet (PANGAEA SegUPerNet layout) on 4 frozen layers; Feature2Pyramid neck x4/x2/x1/maxpool; decoder channels 128 (PANGAEA default 512); neck=fused; PPM scales 1,2,3,6; BN; Dropout2d 0.1; bilinear upsample to 256x256; 2 classes; in_channels 1024
head.decoder: UPerNet (PPM 1,2,3,6 + FPN) on a Feature2Pyramid neck (x4 deconv, x2 deconv, identity, maxpool /2)

training.schedule: cosine decay per step from lr to 0 over max epochs
training.early_stopping: pooled val mIoU (metrics.py, 2 classes); best-epoch weights restored
training.epoch: all A x N (aug, patch) pairs once, seeded shuffle

sidecar.input: S2L2A 12 bands B01 B02 B03 B04 B05 B06 B07 B08 B8A B09 B11 B12 (8 from optical.npy + B01 B06 B07 B09 from s2extra.tif), DN = reflectance*10000, standardised with TerraMind v1 S2L2A pretraining mean/std; S1RTC VV VH dB standardised with TerraMind v1 S1RTC mean/std; pixels with any NaN band set to 0 (band mean) per modality; clouds on all 12 optical bands; 256 px, sin-cos pos-emb built for 16x16; merge_method=mean (S2L2A and S1RTC tokens averaged per position)
sidecar.layer_index: zero-based transformer block index; the last one is after the encoder's final norm
